name: CORMAS
description: CORMAS (Common-pool Resources and Multi-Agent Systems) is an open-source platform specialized in companion modeling and multi-agent simulations for renewable resource management and collective action. It facilitates participatory simulations involving stakeholders to explore social-ecological dilemmas and decision-making processes.
reputation: Highly respected in the companion modeling and common-pool resource research communities for bridging science and stakeholder engagement.
notes: Implemented in Pharo/Smalltalk; strong emphasis on participatory and educational use rather than pure computational scale.
